body_lead: Odisha to house HCLTech's first data centre; ₹15,000 cr AI push planned A first of its kind project in India, the facility will provide secure, scalable and inclusive digital infrastructure for government, research institutions, startups and enterprises India's third largest IT services company HCL Technologies (HCLTech) on Friday announced to set up a world-class global technology centre and an AI-optimised data centre in Bhubaneswar to innovate and deliver AI-led digital solutions to global enterprises. This will be the company's first AI data centre.
